name: Histogram Pyramid-based Octree Construction
definition: A method to initialize pointer octrees by splitting them into an internal node list and a leaf node list, both storing histogram pyramids during construction. Construction is parallel for both lists.
summary: Histogram Pyramid-based Octree Construction is a GPU method that builds octrees by parallelizing internal and leaf node lists via histogram pyramids, differing from standard builders by separating structures for efficient pointer resolution.
